# dcb

In [EhOsContract.Contract](contract-dsl.md), section `contract`.

```elixir
dcb name, label
```

A dynamic consistency boundary: a unit that decides over the events it consults.

**Arguments**

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Docs |
|------|------|----------|---------|------|
| <a id="contract-dcb-name"></a>`name` | `atom` | yes |  | The boundary's name. |
| <a id="contract-dcb-label"></a>`label` | `String.t` | yes |  | What the business calls it. |

**Options**

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Docs |
|------|------|----------|---------|------|
| <a id="contract-dcb-identity"></a>`identity` | `atom \| list(atom)` | yes |  | The fields that identify one boundary; injected into its state, commands and events. |
| <a id="contract-dcb-source"></a>`source` | `String.t` |  |  | Where the boundary comes from in the material. |

Inside it: [`consults`](#contract-dcb-consults), [`state`](#contract-dcb-state), [`invariant`](#contract-dcb-invariant), [`command`](#contract-dcb-command), [`event`](#contract-dcb-event), [`stage`](#contract-dcb-stage).

## dcb.consults

```elixir
consults event
```

An event a dynamic consistency boundary reads before it decides.

**Arguments**

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Docs |
|------|------|----------|---------|------|
| <a id="contract-dcb-consults-event"></a>`event` | `atom` | yes |  | The event read. |

**Options**

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Docs |
|------|------|----------|---------|------|
| <a id="contract-dcb-consults-match"></a>`match` | `atom \| list(atom)` |  | `[]` | Identity fields the event must carry with the boundary's values. |
| <a id="contract-dcb-consults-where"></a>`where` | `String.t` |  |  | The criterion in prose, when fields cannot say it. |

## dcb.state.field

```elixir
field name, type
```

One field of a state, a command, an event or a read model's row.

**Arguments**

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Docs |
|------|------|----------|---------|------|
| <a id="contract-dcb-state-field-name"></a>`name` | `atom` | yes |  | The field's name. |
| <a id="contract-dcb-state-field-type"></a>`type` | `any` | yes |  | A built-in type or a value of the domain. |

**Options**

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Docs |
|------|------|----------|---------|------|
| <a id="contract-dcb-state-field-optional"></a>`optional` | `boolean` |  | `false` | Whether the field may be absent. |
| <a id="contract-dcb-state-field-label"></a>`label` | `String.t` |  |  | What the business calls it. |
| <a id="contract-dcb-state-field-personal"></a>`personal` | `atom` |  |  | The field holding the identifier of whose data this is. |
| <a id="contract-dcb-state-field-subject"></a>`subject` | `atom` |  |  | The domain subject this identifier field identifies. |
| <a id="contract-dcb-state-field-default"></a>`default` | `any` |  |  | The initial value; only in a state. |
| <a id="contract-dcb-state-field-issued_by"></a>`issued_by` | `atom` |  |  | The domain external that gives this value, e.g. a number another system assigns. |
| <a id="contract-dcb-state-field-supplied_by"></a>`supplied_by` | `:host` |  |  | Who gives this field's value instead of the caller: `:host`, through `EhOsContract.Supplier`, for a value a decision depends on that a request could otherwise forge. Only on a command's field, or a recorded event's (F10). |

## dcb.command

```elixir
command name, label
```

An intention an actor or a reaction issues to a unit.

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Docs |
|------|------|----------|---------|------|
| <a id="contract-dcb-command-name"></a>`name` | `atom` | yes |  | The command's name. |

**Options**

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Docs |
|------|------|----------|---------|------|
| <a id="contract-dcb-command-emits"></a>`emits` | `atom \| list(atom)` | yes |  | The events of this unit it may produce. |
| <a id="contract-dcb-command-by"></a>`by` | `atom \| list(atom)` |  | `[]` | The actors who may issue it. |
| <a id="contract-dcb-command-rejects"></a>`rejects` | `atom \| list(atom)` |  | `[]` | The invariants of this unit, and the constraints of this command, it may refuse on. |
| <a id="contract-dcb-command-creates"></a>`creates` | `boolean` |  | `false` | Whether it creates the aggregate, which the library then gives its generated identity. |
| <a id="contract-dcb-command-scope"></a>`scope` | `atom` |  |  | The field a grant narrows it to: a field of the command, and a scope of every actor in `by:`. |
| <a id="contract-dcb-command-source"></a>`source` | `String.t` |  |  | Where the command comes from in the material. |

Inside it: [`field`](#contract-dcb-command-field), [`constraint`](#contract-dcb-command-constraint).

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Docs |

| <a id="contract-dcb-event-depends_on"></a>`depends_on` | `atom` |  |  | The external system the fact depends on. |
| <a id="contract-dcb-event-recorded_by"></a>`recorded_by` | `atom \| list(atom)` |  | `[]` | The actors who record it as an observation, when no command decides it. |
| <a id="contract-dcb-event-schema_version"></a>`schema_version` | `pos_integer` |  | `1` | The version of its fields, raised with an upcaster when history exists; written into each row, and a row of a newer version than the code declares is not read. |
| <a id="contract-dcb-event-source"></a>`source` | `String.t` |  |  | Where the event comes from in the material. |
